hermit.shows: the portrait of the hermit in the dialogue frame

compass.shows: the fixed half of the coordinate line the compass adds to the item screen

battle.shows: the stamina, health and inner-force labels of the acting character's card in a fight

prompt.shows: the yes-or-no prompt of a character who can be asked to join

defeat.shows: the banner the game draws when the party loses a fight

obtained.shows: the first two glyphs, 得到 (obtained), of the message the game centres on screen when an item enters the bag; the box is as wide as the name, so the glyphs are searched along the row
